info.title: DishPlay pilot API
info.description: Implemented DishPlay route handlers. Browser mutations require matching Origin. Native capture endpoints accept missing Origin and use a single-use pairing code or a scoped capture Bearer capability; foreign origins remain rejected. Provides catalogue, private photos, atomic publication, durable capture and an opt-in external PostgreSQL reconstruction queue. No worker/engines run inside Vercel. Reconstruction defaults off and rejects requests without a fresh compatible worker; actual outputs remain private pending human review.

503.description: Disabled deployment, absent PostgreSQL, or no fresh compatible worker; WORKER_UNAVAILABLE

post.description: Requires ENABLE_RECONSTRUCTION=true, PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL, a compatible worker heartbeat younger than 45 seconds, owned finalized JPEG/PNG inputs within the exact frame budget, and an unchanged input manifest. Deduplicates input+engine+settings within the restaurant. Up to three pending jobs per restaurant. No engine is started by the web process. Existing models remain unchanged; completed artifacts need human review.

default.description: Error response; inaccessible jobs return 404.

delete.description: Fences the current attempt immediately and preserves originals/models. Physical capacity stays reserved until process-stop acknowledgement or lease expiry plus grace. Repeated cancellation is idempotent. Other terminal jobs return409 JOB_TERMINAL.

nativeCapability.description: 64 lowercase hex characters generated on the native device, bound to one capture at pairing, seven-day lifetime.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Must exactly equal the destination origin (validated Host header plus request URL protocol) or configured NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL origin. Missing/mismatched origin returns 403 even for signup/login. Forwarded-host headers are not trusted.
